captions.detailed: A pedestal box fan featuring a square-shaped grey housing unit mounted on an adjustable-height support column. The column extends upwards from a circular black base with a prismatic joint, allowing the fan head to slide vertically. Inside the protective wire grille, a five-blade light-grey propeller is mounted on a central revolute axle for free rotation, while a small, black cylindrical timer knob is situated on the rear of the motor housing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a pedestal box fan using CadQuery. The model should include a circular base, an adjustable vertical column, a square fan head housing containing a five-blade propeller behind a wire grille, and a rotary timer knob on the rear of the motor housing.
captions.factory: Construct the circular base using a flat cylinder primitive. Create the telescoping support column by combining a lower square-profile tube with an inner cylindrical rod. Build the square outer fan housing by filleting a hollowed-out box, and place a cylindrical motor housing inside. Model the fan propeller by patterning five angled blades around a central cylinder hub, and construct the wire grille using a grid of thin cylinders. Finally, attach a small cylinder for the rear dial knob.
